sn45.18:1.2: This pair feature in this series of discourses (up until [sn45.20]()) | With the rise of Pāṭaliputta, the “Chicken Monastery” (_kukkuṭārāma_) became an important center after the Buddha’s passing. Malalasekera (*Dictionary of Pali Proper Names*) suggests it was the same monastery later renowned as Aśokārāma.
sn45.18:2.1: Notice that they refer to each other as “reverend”, in apparent violation of one of the Buddha’s final instructions.
